requirements.quote:
BGP speakers MAY negotiate the version of the protocol by making
   multiple attempts at opening a BGP connection, starting with the
   highest version number each BGP speaker supports.  If an open attempt
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker chooses to negotiate the protocol version.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY negotiate the protocol version through multiple attempts to open a BGP connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Connection establishment can be checked for support of repeated version-negotiation attempts; this is permitted behavior, not mandatory support.

requirements.quote:
BGP speakers MAY negotiate the version of the protocol by making
   multiple attempts at opening a BGP connection, starting with the
   highest version number each BGP speaker supports.  If an open attempt
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker uses the described optional repeated-open version negotiation procedure.
requirements.required_behavior: Start with the highest version number that the BGP speaker supports.
requirements.why_checkable: The version selected for the initial negotiation attempt can be compared with the locally supported versions.

requirements.quote:
the highest common version.  In order to support BGP version
   negotiation, future versions of BGP MUST retain the format of the
   OPEN and NOTIFICATION messages.
requirements.condition: A future BGP version supports BGP version negotiation.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST retain the format of OPEN messages.
requirements.why_checkable: The OPEN encoding of a future version can be checked for retention of the existing format.
